h: Davido arrives at Zlatan Ibile's wedding venue in a white Rolls-Royce
p: Singer Davido has reportedly turned up at the venue of Zlatan Ibile and Davita Lamai's wedding in a white Rolls-Royce. A video of his arrival is circulating online, and fans also spotted him in footage of the groom's groomsmen getting ready.
more: A video of his arrival is circulating online.
The traditional ceremony is still going on.

Zlatan Ibile in a green knitted cardigan and glasses
